content: Gāzurgāhī (writing 909/1503-4) lists Ṣāʾin al-Dīn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī among the disciples of Sulṭān Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī in Cairo, alongside Ibn al-Qāżī Rūmī, and says the two spent years in spiritual exercises in the ground-floor apartment (zīrkhāna) of Akhlāṭī's house, with the master living in the upper storey. (MK notes in a footnote that Gāzurgāhī's death date for Akhlāṭī, 777/1375-76, is incorrect.)
refers_to_primary: Kamāl al-Dīn Ḥusayn Gāzurgāhī, Majālis al-ʿUshshāq (909/1503-4), majlis 34, 189
